description: Explicit exceptions linking the polygon name (Bacias_Hidrograficas_SIN.zip, field Nome_Bacia) to the nom_bacia of the ONS per-basin ENA/EAR series. Names that match after removing accents/hyphens are linked automatically; the rest stays unmatched (membership is not inferred).

justification.Itajaí-Açu: Same river; the ENA series uses the short name ITAJAI.
justification.Uatuamã: Polygon spelling differs from UATUMA (Uatumã river, Balbina HPP) in the ENA series.

unmatched_note: Correntes, Tapajós, Manso, Itiquira and Jauru have no equivalent nom_bacia in the per-basin ENA (e.g. ENA uses PARAGUAI and TELES PIRES). Linking them needs a plant→basin mapping, not yet built.
